posts.title: SFT, RL, and On-Policy Distillation Through a Distributional Lens
posts.description: I have been thinking about post-training methods in terms of distributions. A language model is a distribution over sequences. When we post-train it and attempt to teach it a task, we are reshaping this distribution.
